# CustomTimeSeriesSplit { #wass2s.CustomTimeSeriesSplit }

```python
CustomTimeSeriesSplit(n_splits)
```

Custom time series cross-validator for splitting data into training and test sets.

Ensures temporal ordering is maintained by generating training and test indices
suitable for time series data, with an option to omit samples after the test index.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                                | Default    |
|----------|--------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| n_splits | int    | Number of splits for the cross-validation. | _required_ |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_n_splits](#wass2s.CustomTimeSeriesSplit.get_n_splits) | Return the number of splits for the cross-validation. |
| [split](#wass2s.CustomTimeSeriesSplit.split) | Generate indices to split data into training and test sets. |

### get_n_splits { #wass2s.CustomTimeSeriesSplit.get_n_splits }

```python
CustomTimeSeriesSplit.get_n_splits(X=None, y=None, groups=None)
```

Return the number of splits for the cross-validation.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                    | Default   |
|--------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| X      | array - like | The data to be split (ignored in this implementation).         | `None`    |
| y      | array - like | The target variable (ignored in this implementation).          | `None`    |
| groups | array - like | Group labels for the samples (ignored in this implementation). | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                              |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | int    | The number of splits configured for the cross-validator. |

### split { #wass2s.CustomTimeSeriesSplit.split }

```python
CustomTimeSeriesSplit.split(X, nb_omit, y=None, groups=None)
```

Generate indices to split data into training and test sets.

Yields training indices before the test index (excluding a specified number of samples
after the test index) and test indices for each split.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type         | Description                                                                         | Default    |
|---------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| X       | array - like | The data to be split, typically time series data.                                   | _required_ |
| nb_omit | int          | Number of samples to omit from training after the test index to avoid data leakage. | _required_ |
| y       | array - like | The target variable (ignored in this implementation).                               | `None`     |
| groups  | array - like | Group labels for the samples (ignored in this implementation).                      | `None`     |

#### Yields {.doc-section .doc-section-yields}

| Name          | Type    | Description                                     |
|---------------|---------|-------------------------------------------------|
| train_indices | ndarray | The training set indices for the current split. |
| test_indices  | list    | The test set indices for the current split.     |
